title: Unvented Cylinder Servicing London | G3 Engineer
description: Discuss unvented cylinder servicing in london. Diagnosis-led support, clear scope and postcode-based availability. Call 020 7205 4433.
answer: A planned cylinder service checks the safety and operating arrangements for the actual model, not just whether a tap runs hot.

sections.heading: What the service addresses
paragraphs: An annual service is the manufacturer-recommended routine for many unvented cylinders, including Megaflo. It is different from a gas-boiler service and should follow the cylinder instructions. The visit may include the expansion provision, inlet controls, relief devices, visible discharge route, temperature controls and evidence of leakage. The precise checks depend on the make, model and configuration.

sections.heading: Planning the visit
paragraphs: Bring the commissioning checklist, previous service notes and any guarantee paperwork together before the appointment. If an earlier visit found a defect, tell us what action was recommended. Cupboard storage should not prevent access to the appliance or controls.

sections.heading: Clear scope and practical next steps
paragraphs: A completed service record can help demonstrate what was checked. It is not a replacement for installation notification, a gas safety record or a legionella risk assessment. Repairs found during a service should have a separately explained scope.

sections.heading: Arrange an enquiry
paragraphs: Contact 020 7205 4433 with your postcode, equipment make and model, symptoms and access details. The enquiry is used to establish the appropriate work and appointment availability. Costs and scope are discussed before agreed work.

faqs.question: What should I prepare before an unvented cylinder service?
faqs.answer: Have the model label, previous service record and access details ready; clear stored items without moving pipework or controls.
